posts.title: Chord Cut is now free to try
posts.description: Chord Cut 1.2 is out today, and the game is now free on the App Store. The first three levels are free, and a one-time $2.99 purchase unlocks the other seven. If you already bought it, you keep everything, no action needed. A few things changed since launch based on player feedback. Hitting a rock no longer resets your score to zero, your score is now banked at the start of each level. Pineapples

posts.title: Chord Cut: an open-source game where every cut plays a piano chord
posts.description: ALT Chord Cut: an open-source game where every cut plays a piano chord Today I released Chord Cut , a casual generative soundtrack game where every cut composes the soundtrack, and it’s open source under the GPLv3.
